## Basis (the standing legal fact)

The DHS Office of Inspector General is a U.S. federal government office; its reports are works of the
United States Government. Under **17 U.S.C. §105** they are not subject to copyright in the U.S. and
are in the public domain. SIG stores derived facts + locators, never any third-party inclusions.

packet wins over the GL-GATE-07 US default, per the P29.3 gate answer).

## Procured / reviewed ≠ deployed

An OIG finding is an `AccountabilityEvent` (§11.17) — never a deployment or device-count claim.
